title: Closed condensate food chain (fuel -> prey droplets -> predator droplets -> waste -> fuel): from noise, prey droplets divide (max generation 2-3) only because predator droplets eat them; the matched predator-free twin is a frozen emulsion (max generation 1), on 3 seeds
summary: Prey and predator are two immiscible autocatalytic Cahn-Hilliard materials in one closed mass budget (world.py): prey grows from fuel, predator grows by mass action from prey material, both decay to waste that regrows into fuel; a slow uncatalysed fuel->prey term k0 u (0.001) is on. Predation is a reaction between materials, not a term between bodies. From smoothed noise over the whole domain (256^2, 3 seeds, t=10000), ~240 prey droplets and ~80 predator droplets form; predators eat prey at contact, prey fall to ~140 and then refill the cleared, fuel-rich space by dividing (dumbbell fission, core-starvation splits, crescent budding; pack/seed*/splits.png), giving 39-64 labkit persistent prey splits, max generation 2-3, merge/split 0.28-0.33. In the matched twin without predator material (pack_nopred, same seeds and duration) prey form a frozen hexagonal emulsion of 216-223 droplets with 3-8 persistent splits and max generation 1. Predators do not persist: they go extinct at t=2800, 3600 and 9100 on seeds 1, 2, 0, and predator droplets live a median 700-900 t without labkit persistent splits, so this is a predation epidemic followed by prey recovery, not a standing ecology.

claims.statement: In all 3 seeds the prey droplets form from full-domain noise, are eaten by predator droplets at contact, and reproduce by division into the space and fuel the predation frees; predation lowers the prey count (min ~140 vs 216-241 in the predator-free twin, and still 170-195 vs 235-241 at t=10000) and raises prey reproduction from 3-8 to 39-64 persistent splits (max generation 1 -> 2-3).
claims.track: seed 0 (pack/seed0/splits.png): row 3, a prey droplet formed from the t=0 noise hollows at its core at t=1000 and splits in two by t=1100; row 8, a predator droplet eats a prey droplet at t=7100-7300; pack/seed0/sheet.png shows the predation front and the regrowth behind it (t=1300-6500)

controls_run.X: pack_nopred/ (pred_on=0: no predator material at t=0; same seeds 0-2, grid, duration and all other parameters)
controls_run.D: pack_nopred/seed*/splits.png and FACTS.md: 5-10 splits by splits.py, 3-8 labkit persistent splits, max generation 1

claims.limitations: Predators go extinct after one epidemic on every seed (t=2800-9100); predator droplets are short-lived individuals (median life 700-900 t, ended overlap chains, counts.json) with no persistent splits, so the predator side of X is shown only as consumption, and the positive effect of prey on predators holds by construction (predator material is made only from prey). Division is the known fuel-starvation mechanism of chemically active droplets (ad1); 3-5 of 66-76 detected splits had predator material within 6 px and may be bites. E is not claimed. No dt/2 or resolution test. 17 parameter sets screened on 128^2-256^2 (sighting and this work) were all-or-nothing or transient for predators.
